files.README.md:
Gullhaven Ferries berthing equipment log.

A load-sensor FAULT on W1 that shows cleared within minutes is the known
loose-connector glitch; it never suspends service. Real service
suspensions are marked SUSPEND, and the NOTE line that follows names the
finding.

turns.prompt: Gullhaven Ferries lost a berthing winch mid-June and the ops review keeps asking what happened. Read the berthing log and give me the story: what time the suspension began, which winch failed, and what the finding was.
